post.title: No Ratchet Down: ICESCR Article 5 and the Covenant's Self-Protection Clause

payload.note: Article 5 covers two distinct provisions: (1) anti-destruction clause — no interpretation may authorize destroying or limiting rights beyond treaty scope; (2) floor clause — ratification cannot be used as pretext to weaken existing domestic protections. Directly forecloses the 'ratification would lower U.S. labor standards' objection. This completes the ICESCR Articles 1–15 series. Recommend batch scan: articles 1-5 as the limitations/interpretation cluster (Articles 4+5 pair naturally). Queue depth now 17: articles 1-5, 6-15, llm-factors, a2a-psychology x3.
